business_problem: Before shifting from AI research to enterprise products, ElevenLabs’ legacy database lacked native free-text search, draining engineering time.
solution_summary: Before shifting from AI research to enterprise products, ElevenLabs’ legacy database lacked native free-text search, draining engineering time. ElevenLabs moved to MongoDB on Google Cloud, eliminating separate index stores and sync code to bring simplicity to its data tier. The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has transformed how global enterprises interact with audiences, shifting the focus from simple text interfaces to audio experiences. During the initial wave of the generative AI boom in 2022, London startup ElevenLabs set out to change the way humans interact with businesses through technology by building APIs for audio models. “Our voice Text to Speech model was revolutionary,” said Alex Holt, Field CTO at ElevenLabs. “It was the first AI model that sounded human.” However, ElevenLabs soon realized that deploying exceptional voice models was only part of the operational matrix.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind ElevenLabs's AI-powered search and assistant experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Google Cloud, APIs.
business_outcome: A stable data layer unlocked hyper-growth for ElevenLabs, driving it to $600M ARR and powering millions of global voice and chat agents.
architecture_clues: AI agents or assistants are layered on top of the MongoDB data platform.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
